title: Certificate Transparency for Cloud Hosts
summary: Use CT logs to find cloud hostnames and SaaS endpoints.
objective: Discover staging/api/cdn hostnames from public certificates.
steps: Filter cloud keywords: s3, blob, cloudfront, azure, appspot, vercel.
Group by env hints: staging, dev, uat, api.
Validate live hosts only when authorized.
ethics: Authorized investigations and public sources only. Do not access systems without permission.
